description: Ten-year asset management plan of a fictional water utility (cover, 9 chapters with 9 templated treatment-works profiles and 24 templated supply-zone profiles, tables, glossary, a 600-row mains renewal schedule, a reservoir schedule and an approval record), 84 A4 pages (85 after the edits), printed by Chromium with running header and "Page X of Y" footer. Eight scattered edits: a paragraph and a five-row table inserted in section 1.3 on page 2, which push every later page down by about a third of a page (so every later page break, table split and repeated table header moves, and the document gains a page); a trunk-mains length in the Elmscar asset table; a sentence deleted in the Ivelstone condition paragraph; "quarterly" to "monthly" in the Pellow Bay risk paragraph; a missing minus sign restored on the Energy variance in the 2025/26 budget table (the old version printed 1,250 for an overspend); a new row R-16 added to the risk register; a scheme length in the 600-row mains renewal schedule in Appendix B; and the Board approval date on the last page. Zone totals, the capital programme and all other figures are unchanged. Re-flow, page breaks, repeated table header rows and footer page numbers change only as consequences. Producer: Chromium (Skia/PDF m153, Playwright page.pdf), HTML/CSS, Liberation Serif/Sans.

truth.new: In response to consultation feedback, this version also sets out how the Authority will report progress against the plan to customers each year
